title: tares factory setup apply -: what happened to each setup operation (also setup --apply -)
description: One document, printed with and without --json. The operations are applied in order and a failed one does not stop the rest, so `results` has one row per operation of the input. An input that cannot be run sends nothing and prints error.json (`bad_input`), as does a Tares that does not answer at the start. No settings value of a failed operation is repeated: it reads `***`.

ok.description: True when every operation was applied (exit 0), false when one was not (exit 1).

name.description: The integration, as the input named it.

status.description: The HTTP status of the cell's answer; 200 for an applied operation. Null when no answer settles it: none came, or what came was not Tares confirming.

code.description: Null for an applied operation. Else `admin_required`, `key_refused`, `licence_required`, `forbidden`, `cell_too_old` or `tares_error`; a caller treats a code it does not know like `tares_error`.

detail.description: Null for an applied operation, else a sentence for a person. Not for parsing.
